summary: Zackaria White, 21, of Pine, separated from his partner at the Knife Edge, took a non-standard descent and fell 600-700 feet to his death on Capitol Peak
notes: Fell Saturday Aug 26; found Sunday Aug 27; Merged 2 reports (parts: aac, news-2010-2019); date per both sources.
